scope: New-thread conversion UI, provider-scoped existing-chat menu, retained mobile composer
behavior: Existing thread composer renders only exact provider/alias rows; unlabelled compatibility requires complete entirely legacy directory. Shared catalog and new-chat/automation selectors remain global.

Foreign saved options are retained while identity/alias is incomplete; uncertain input is blocked. A complete catalog proving mismatch clears only model/modelProvider/effort, retaining text/attachments/other settings.

Independent menu selects target model/effort then requires two intentional confirmations. No input, original-history mutation or draft option change occurs. thread/convert receives explicit source/target/model/confirm only.
Current-provider compatibility copy remains selectable; source must be loaded and idle. Removed source configuration needs restoration; no hidden cold-conversion path.
Pending conversion marks current context busy synchronously; durable pending/unknown receipt prevents automatic resume on source thread/closed. Terminal proof restores ordinary source loading.
Accepted result requires distinct new ID; lost response queries original receipt only. Navigation uses existing draft-safe handoff, with completion link if local draft cannot be saved.
Old inline consent, backup dialog, special abandon hook and obsolete tests removed. Core/gateway/API changes belong to root/runtime authors.

Mobile composer changes retained; 16px inputs, grouped toolbars, fixed short-viewport model panel. Earlier parent browser evidence remains scoped to those CSS bytes; new dialog browser QA pending root.

tests.boundary: Real App, Api durable operations, useWorkflow and draft hooks with local fetch/WebSocket fixtures; no native inference or production calls.
Actual sidebar hook and event bus, fake timers only for defined 100ms coalescing.

build.warning: Existing chunk-size warning; not an error.

checks.lineEndings: All listed source and tests normalized to LF after semantic targeted run.

limitations: No full suite, deployment, external MCP or paid inference.
Parent performs desktop/mobile browser QA and independent UI review.
This author report is not a repository audit or release authorization.
Prior three-step / in-place conversion evidence is preserved as superseded historical behavior, not claimed as current.
